scope.description: Deterministic main-content extraction from cached public HTML against human-reviewed WCEB annotations.
scope.metric: Macro average of page-level Unicode word precision, recall, and F1; snippet rates use case-insensitive literal inclusion.
intendedClaims: main-content extraction quality on the pinned WCEB split
required-content retention and unwanted-boilerplate inclusion on the pinned WCEB split
excludedClaims: competitor ranking without an identical independently reviewed protocol
scope.interpretation: The upstream split name is preserved, but this project previously inspected and iterated against the 511-page test split. Neither split is presented as fresh confirmatory evidence.
